text: Pilot hypothesis: crew onboarding and bounded operations knowledge assistant
description: Map role-specific onboarding, shift prerequisites, site knowledge, escalation paths, and approved FAQs into an inspectable graph. A permissioned assistant answers only from approved sources, cites them, records unanswered questions, and escalates safety/access/people issues. Measure repeated coordinator questions, response time, onboarding hours, and unresolved knowledge gaps. Do not automate scheduling, access grants, disciplinary matters, or safety decisions in the first pilot.

status.comment: Workflow hypothesis awaiting operator evidence; do not build before validating real pain, ownership, artifacts, baseline, and willingness to pay.
